content: The failure of normal plasma volume expansion in pregnant women is linked to impaired fetal growth and the development of pre-eclampsia. The purpose of this review was to evaluate the effects of plasma volume expansion in cases where impaired fetal growth is suspected. A search was conducted in the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group's Trials Register as of March 2010. The review included randomized or quasi-randomized trials comparing plasma volume expansion to no plasma volume expansion in women with suspected impaired fetal growth. The quality of the trials was assessed. However, no studies met the inclusion criteria for this review. Consequently, there is insufficient evidence to determine the effectiveness of plasma volume expansion in cases of suspected impaired fetal growth.
